definition: An overlay read off a plan, such as the datums, the daylight reach or the wet stacks, means nothing once the model is turned freely, so a free view does not draw it, and says it withheld it rather than leaving it silently off.
basis: Our wording of the rule for overlays in the model. docs/scene.md withholds from a view what cannot be read there: "Every one of those is a measurement read off the plate". docs/workbench.md: the "daylight overlay is gated on the same test, so overlay and drawing cannot contradict" each other.
